author: The Current
description:
Singer-songwriter Amythyst Kiah spoke to host Jill Riley on how it felt to lose Dolly Parton as a Tennessean. 

Amythyst Kiah will be performing at The Parkway Theater on Friday, November 13. 

Listen and read to the full interview at thecurrent.org
